newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Imaging rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Imaging rated buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Applied Imaging Corp with a buy rating.
-- Its one-year price target for the company's stock is $14.
-- Analyst Benjamin Andrew in a report said the company's prenatal screening system has strong market potential.
-- Vector's EPS estimate for the company is for a loss of $0.55 in 1996.
-- Applied Imaging was trading unchanged at 6-5/8.
